title: Humanized but Still True? Auditing Facts and Detection in AI-Text Humanizers
abstract: arXiv:2611.00359v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI "humanizers" rewrite machine-generated text so that detectors classify it as human-written. Public leaderboards score evasion and embedding similarity, but not whether checkable details survive. We check whether numbers, dates, person and organization names, and quoted spans survive each rewrite, using a rule-based checker validated by two AI annotators (precision 0.84-1.00, recall 0.93-0.95; no human annotation). In the October 2026 cycle of a public humanizer leaderboard, all 11 commercial tools changed or dropped at least one of these units in 35-65% of the documents that contained one. Most changes were to quoted spans; counting numbers and names alone, 10 of the 11 tools still altered at least one in 20% or more of the documents. The September 2026 cycle was similar (19-50%). An open 12B humanizer kept at least 97% of numbers and names in fact-dense U.S. federal agency text, but reworded 67-78% of the quoted spans, against its ow

translated_title: 人性化但仍真实？对AI文本“人性化器”中的事实与检测的审计
translated_abstract: AI“人性化器”通过重写机器生成的文本，使AI检测器将其判定为人类撰写。公开排行榜对规避检测能力和嵌入相似度进行评分，但并未评估可核查的细节是否得以保留。我们检验了数字、日期、人名与组织名称以及引用片段在每次重写后是否得以保留，所使用的基于规则的检查器由两个AI标注器验证（精确率0.84-1.00，召回率0.93-0.95；无人工标注）。在2026年10月周期的公开人性化器排行榜中，全部11款商业工具都在35-65%包含此类信息单元的文档中更改或丢弃了至少一个单元。大多数更改发生在引用片段上；仅统计数字和名称，11款工具中仍有10款在20%以上的文档中更改了至少一个。2026年9月周期的情况类似（19-50%）。一款开源的12B参数人性化器在事实密集的美国联邦机构文本中保留了至少97%的数字和名称，但重写了67-78%的引用片段，这与它自身的……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文首次对AI文本“人性化器”的事实保真度进行系统审计，发现全部11款商业工具都会在相当比例的文档中更改或丢失数字、日期、名称等事实细节，揭示了规避AI检测与保持文本真实性之间的矛盾。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic audit of factual fidelity in AI-text humanizers, showing that all 11 commercial tools alter or drop checkable details like numbers, dates, and names in a substantial fraction of documents, exposing the tension between evading AI detection and preserving truthfulness.
